stories.title: Game Recap — Imanaga and Bregman End the Slide
stories.angle: Cubs routed Pirates 12-2 Thursday afternoon. Imanaga went 6 IP (2 ER) and improved to 10-10. Bregman had 3 hits and a 2-run HR (25th of season, 16th since the break). Suzuki added 3 hits including a triple. Busch drove in 3. 16 total hits, every starter on base. Four-game losing streak snapped. Lead with narrative/stats — NOT the score (has_score=False insight).

x_posts.label: Post 1
x_posts.text:
Four-game skid? Gone.

Imanaga delivered 6 solid innings, Bregman launched his 25th homer (16th since the break), and 16 hits later, the Cubs looked EXACTLY like a playoff team should.

The offense is awake. The losing streak is over.

#Cubs #GoCubs #FlyTheW

stories.title: PCA 40-40 Chase — Four Steals From History
stories.angle: PCA at 41 HR / 36 SB. Four steals from 40-40, which only six players in MLB history have achieved. No Cub has ever done it. 16 games remain. The chase is very much live.

x_posts.label: Post 2
x_posts.text:
Four steals from history.

Pete Crow-Armstrong is at 41 HR / 36 SB — 4 stolen bases away from the 40-40 club. Six players ever. No Cub has EVER done it.

With 16 games left, the countdown is live.

#Cubs #GoCubs #ChicagoCubs

stories.title: Wild Card Watch — Cubs and Phillies Neck and Neck for WC1
stories.angle: Cubs 82-66 essentially tied with Phillies for WC1 seed (home-field in Wild Card Series). Cardinals eliminated from contention. Every game down the stretch matters. Rival jab included.

x_posts.label: Post 3
x_posts.text:
Neck and neck for WC1.

Cubs at 82-66 are essentially tied with the Phillies for the top NL Wild Card seed — meaning home field in October. Every game matters. 16 left.

Cardinals watching from home. As they should.

#Cubs #NorthSiders #MLB

stories.title: Holmes vs Skenes Preview — Cubs Have the Pitching Edge
stories.angle: Clay Holmes has a 1.55 ERA since the trade deadline (29 IP, 5 starts). Paul Skenes won the 2025 NL Cy Young but is 10-11/3.83 ERA this season — he's mortal. Bold take on Cubs' pitching advantage heading into Game 2.

x_posts.label: Post 4
x_posts.text:
1.55 ERA since the deadline. That's what Clay Holmes brings to Game 2 today.

Paul Skenes has the name — and a 3.83 ERA in 2026 to show he's mortal. Holmes is not. First pitch 1:20 PM CT at Wrigley.

#Cubs #GoCubs #FlyTheW

stories.title: Swanson Return — Targeting Sept 18 in Cincinnati
stories.angle: Dansby Swanson begins Iowa rehab this week (Tue/Wed). Cubs targeting activation September 18 in Cincinnati. Out since Aug 16 with Grade 2 oblique. Two-time Gold Glover returning right on time for October.

x_posts.label: Post 6
x_posts.text:
October just got better.

Dansby Swanson starts his Iowa rehab this week — and the Cubs are targeting his return for September 18 in Cincinnati. Grade 2 oblique, nearly a month on the shelf. The two-time Gold Glover is almost back.

#Cubs #CubsBaseball #MLB
